content.title: 2027 Masters Tournament Dates and Schedule
content.text: The 2027 Masters Tournament will be the 91st time this golf tournament is played. The Masters is one of the four major championships of men's professional golf (along with the PGA Championship, U.S. Open and British Open). It is the first of the four played each year, and the only one played at the same golf course every year. In 2027, The Masters will take place April 8-11. 2027 Masters dates: The four-round, 72-hole tournament will be played from Thursday, April 8, through Sunday, April 11. Golf course: Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia (View the Augusta National scorecard and hole names) Defending champion: Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters by one stroke over Scottie Scheffler. McIlroy also won in 2025, and he is the fourth golfer in Masters history to win back-to-back. He'll try to become the first-ever back-to-back-to-back Masters champ in 2027.Ticket Information Each year Augusta National conducts a lottery to award tickets for practice days, and also to award a very small number of tournament day tickets. See the Tickets section of Masters.com for information. Those not lucky enough to get tickets through the annual drawing will mostly like have the secondary market — ticket brokers — as their only other option for getting tickets.Player Invitations The Masters, like all of the majors, uses a set of "exemption criteria" to fill its field. When a golfer meets one or more of those criteria, he is on the list to receive an invitation to play in the tournament. See How Golfers Qualify to Play in The Masters for the ways in which a player can earn an invitation. Once the field is set, the Augusta National tournament committee is responsible for determining the player groupings and tee times for the first two rounds. Those pairings are announced two days before the start of the tournament. See Masters Tee Times and Pairings for general info.
